//: Type checking only — no emit, no build role. Vite still compiles the app.
checkJs is false on purpose. Turning it on across src/ surfaces 99 errors in
components and core that have nothing to do with why this exists, and a check
nobody can get to zero is a check everyone learns to ignore.
Instead each file opts in with `// @ts-check` at the top. The opted-in set is
the hook and context boundary: hooks/, context/, and AppDesktop.jsx, which is
where almost every hook is called from. That is the boundary where a dropped
option silently disables a feature (see PR #94), and typing it is what makes
`npm run typecheck` fail when a call site forgets one.
Widening the set is a file-by-file decision: add the pragma, fix what it
reports. strict stays off until that set is much larger.
